Introduction
This document 
 lists the testing procedures P1, which must be carried out on an annually 
 bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The
 MCGG63 relay is designed specially for over current with time
 delayed element the MCGG63 manufactured by GEC
The
 first draft initiated by eng. Fahmy Abdel Khalek, tested by
 eng. Hanan El_Badrawy at 18 June 2003, revised by quality
 control eng. Adel Abdel Kader El-Nagar at EDEPCo., accepted
 by general director eng. Mahmoud Saker and approved by eng.
 Mostafa Alam Head Sector of TAlkha PS.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued
 and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the
 suitable safety category.
